title: Stationary deterministic-time modulus versus stopping-time Aldous promotion
question: What temporal modulus follows exactly from the pinned PAH-OMC-010 C_sw and R-522 C2 bounds, and do those pi-weighted bounds alone justify the stopping-time clause used in the R-541 path-tightness wording?
purpose: Correct the promotion boundary without mutating R-541: retain the finite deterministic-time stationary L2 increment estimate, isolate the missing conditional/pointwise domination needed for Aldous stopping-time tightness, and give an abstract reversible two-state diagnostic showing why the implication is not automatic.

exact_scope.finite_processes: Exactly the original finite PAH-001 stationary chains and labelled Gibbs laws at the registered finite levels and radial cutoffs.
exact_scope.source_inputs: R-490 C_sw=540 and R-522 C2(A)<=60|A| remain pi-weighted domination inputs; neither is reinterpreted as a pointwise-in-state rate bound.
exact_scope.deterministic_modulus: For every deterministic t and delta>=0, stationarity plus the finite martingale/drift decomposition gives E|f(X_(t+delta))-f(X_t)|^2 <= 2 delta K_Gamma(f)+2 delta^2 K_L(f).
exact_scope.stopping_time_boundary: Aldous requires the analogous estimate uniformly for bounded stopping times tau. The source inputs alone do not supply the conditional predictable-compensator or pointwise bound needed for that step.
exact_scope.diagnostic: An abstract reversible two-state continuous-time chain with rare high-rate state is used only to disprove the logical implication from a stationary weighted average to a stopping-time bound; it is not a PAH counterexample or a new PAH carrier.
exact_scope.order_and_time: The registered j-before-anchored-n order and external stochastic Markov time are unchanged.

proof_obligations: Revalidate all parent source hashes and distinguish R-490/R-522 stationary averages from pointwise conditional estimates.
Derive the deterministic-time stationary two-square envelope with the unchanged K_Gamma and K_L formulas.
Show by an exact reversible two-state rare-state diagnostic that a bounded stopping time can select a high-rate state while the stationary weighted average tends to zero.
State the one missing owner assumption: a source-authorized uniform conditional compensator or pointwise local rate bound for every bounded stopping time.
Keep the correction nonphysical and do not call the abstract diagnostic an exact PAH negative result.

acceptance.primary: Exact rational source replay, deterministic-time envelope and rare-state scaling diagnostic with no mutation of PAH-001.
acceptance.independent: Non-importing reconstruction of the stationary average and the stopping-time gap using a distinct set of rational M values.
acceptance.hostile: Reject pointwise substitution of C_sw/C2, promotion of deterministic increments to Aldous tightness, and any PAH/physical counterexample claim.
acceptance.lean: Compile finite rational declarations for the two-state stationary weighted rate identity, the rare-state scaling fixture and the deterministic envelope algebra.

outcomes.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Only if a source-authorized conditional compensator/pointwise rate packet is supplied and the stopping-time estimate is independently proved; this correction contract alone cannot produce that verdict.
outcomes.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Reserved for an exact PAH-specific failure of the deterministic stationary envelope or its source assumptions. The abstract rare-state diagnostic is not such a failure.
outcomes.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: The deterministic stationary modulus is verified, but stopping-time Aldous promotion remains unproved until the one conditional owner input is supplied.

single_next_question: Can the unchanged PAH-001 source owner provide a uniform conditional predictable-compensator or pointwise local-rate estimate that upgrades the deterministic stationary modulus to the bounded-stopping-time Aldous condition?
non_claims: No alteration to PAH-001 functional, rates, state, carrier, regulator, normalization, time or limit order.
No claim that the abstract rare-state diagnostic is a PAH counterexample; it only blocks an implication from stationary weighted averages to stopping-time control.
No Aldous tightness, path-space construction, non-explosion, martingale-problem identification, R-512 semigroup convergence or infinite-volume process.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang-Mills or TOE conclusion.
